analogy.rationale: The annotated targets are connexin gap-junction proteins (GJA/GJB family), not the canonical HSD11B enzymes, and these cell lines express little to no connexin-linked steroidogenic machinery; 11-beta HSD inhibitors act on cortisol/cortisone interconversion, so only other steroid-pathway or nuclear-receptor classes would be expected to show any related but still minimal transcriptional response.
